verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents a dedicated Resolve tool that resolves conflicts across many files at once, which is the core of this story. The claim rests on a single thin first-party mention. missing for 10: detail on how the Resolve tool works (e.g. choosing ours/theirs per file or per hunk, the conflict-editing interface), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can resolve merge conflicts across many files at once with a dedicated tool

citations.quote: A faster solution is to use the Resolve tool that lets you resolve conflicts for many files at once.
